name: Balthor
description: War veteran who goes to Otaria and forges a sword for Matoc.

description_citations.text: "The Secrets of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor survives the Phyrexian Invasion and retrieves Urza's staff.
timeline.quote: managing to retrieve nothing less than Urza 's staff

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor meets Matoc, they kill the warhounds and travel home to Otaria, where Balthor joins Matoc's clan.
timeline.quote: The barbarian invited Balthor to join his clan.

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor forges Matoc a blade from Urza's staff.
timeline.quote: Balthor forged Matoc a blade from Urza's Staff.

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor joins Matoc's tribe and forges Matoc a sword from Urza's staff.
timeline.quote: Balthor forges a new sword for Matoc

citation.text: "The Secrets of Magic", section "Journey Home , by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor travels with Jeska to Cabal City to find Kamahl and fights in the pits, without success.
timeline.quote: briefly fighting in the pits alongside her

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor opposes Kamahl when the Mirari drives him to take over all the tribes; Jeska is mortally wounded and Kamahl comes to his senses.
timeline.quote: Following Jeska's mortal wounding, Kamahl snapped out of the Mirari's influence

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor and Kamahl are ambushed in Krosa by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under Laquatus.
timeline.quote: they were ambushed by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under the influence of Ambassador Laquatus

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor lets Kamahl flee and sacrifices himself to destroy Burke as it suffocates him.
timeline.quote: Balthor let Kamahl flee into the forest and sacrificed himself

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses his right arm to Jeska's explosive bolt in the pits and receives a golem arm paid for by Skellum.
timeline.quote: where he lost his right arm when he was hit by one of Jeska’s explosive bolts

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl attaches the Mirari to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force.
timeline.quote: He attached it to the pommel of his sword and tried to use its power to unite the Pardic barbarians under his rule.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabalists raise Balthor as a zombie, Balthor the Defiled, who hunts Laquatus.
timeline.quote: The Cabalists raised him as a zombie

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the Defiled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus controls Balthor and forces him to fight Kamahl; Balthor begs to be killed and Kamahl does so, then kills Laquatus.
timeline.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his suffering

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the Defiled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids zombifies Balthor in revenge for Leer and sets him against Laquatus before teleporting away.
timeline.quote: Braids then zombified Balthor in revenge for him killing Leer

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska says she and Kamahl both come from Balthor's forge.
timeline.quote: My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge.

citation.text: Jeska, Warrior Adept (Judgment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Balthor's spirit guides Kamahl to the Mirari-sword, then is struck down by it for the last time, bringing Kamahl to his senses.
timeline.quote: Balthor intervened only to be struck by the sword and killed for the last time

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the spirit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus and Eesha try to obtain the Mirari while Jeska and Balthor try to separate it from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence.
timeline.quote: attempt to obtain the potent orb for themselves

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl unites the tribes, defeats the Elite Eight with excessive power and plunges the tribes into civil war.
timeline.quote: he proclaims himself champion; many, however, refuse his rule because he has gone mad with power, plunging the tribes into civil war.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska and Balthor decide to steal the Mirari; Jeska knocks Balthor out and fights Kamahl, who strikes her after a false report that she killed Balthor.
timeline.quote: Balthor arrives to clear the misunderstanding, and Kamahl realizes his tragic mistake.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cabal troops attack the village; the barbarians unite and win, and Kamahl resolves to bring the surviving Jeska to Seton, with Balthor carrying the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: Kamahl resolves to bring her to his friend Seton , deep in the Krosan forest, to cure her.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the forest's edge Balthor holds off the pursuers and unleashes a great spell that kills himself and Burke; Laquatus discovers his troops were wiped out by Llawan's and forges a flimsy alliance with the Cabal and Order.
timeline.quote: the dwarf unleashes a great spell that kills them both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl discovers the assailant is Balthor, zombified by Braids, and ends his undeath in tears.
timeline.quote: he is Balthor, zombified by Braids and instructed to kill Laquatus.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl returns home, is dominated by the Mirari and tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, dividing the barbarians.
timeline.quote: Initially, he was content simply to return home covered in glory, but inevitably, the Mirari dominated his mind.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl and the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Attacked at the edge of the Krosan forest, Balthor sacrifices himself so Kamahl can flee with Jeska; Seton guides Kamahl in and Thriss teaches him druidism.
timeline.quote: Balthor chose to sacrifice himself to let Kamahl flee with Jeska.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus mind-controls zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who is forced to strike down his old mentor at Balthor's plea.
timeline.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his torment, and so Kamahl was forced to strike down his old mentor.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl meets Karona, then resolves she must be stopped; he retrieves the Mirari from Laquatus's corpse with Balthor's ghost's help.
timeline.quote: it was only through Balthor's spiritual sacrifice that Kamahl managed to gain control over the Mirari-sword

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl, guided by Balthor's ghost, retrieves his sword from Laquatus's corpse and defeats the giant Laquatus again.
timeline.quote: Kamahl has to defeat his old nemesis again

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl masters the Mirari only by slaying Balthor's phantom in a rage.
timeline.quote: a feat which is accomplished only when he slays the phantom in a fit of rage

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and Jeska are led into the Krosan Forest by Balthor Rockfist, pursued by the Cabal and Order remnants and Llawan's armies.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and his mortally wounded sister ventured into the Krosan Forest

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Krosa, Laquatus's alliance collapses as Seton's druids resist and the undead Balthor hunts Laquatus.
timeline.quote: The alliance collapsed under its treacheries

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4205 AR Balthor Rockfist and Matoc arrived at Auror; Balthor fought Galdan in a duel and was accepted into the tribe.
timeline.quote: Galdan accepted Balthor into their tribe

citation.text: "Auror", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor reforged Urza's staff into a great sword for Matoc.
timeline.quote: Balthor then reforged Urza 's staff, recovered in battle, into a great sword for Matoc

citation.text: "Auror", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor destroys Burke with a suicide fire spell as Laquatus tries to seize the Mirari.
timeline.quote: he was destroyed by Balthor when Laquatus tried to seize the Mirari

citation.text: "Burke", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A small part of Burke remaining in Balthor's throat lets Laquatus control Balthor after Braids turns him into a zombie.
timeline.quote: a small part of Burke remaining in his throat enabled Laquatus to take control of Balthor

citation.text: "Burke", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor summons Fiers's power, a continual bolt of lightning that destroys Burke.
timeline.quote: Balthor Rockfist summoned the power of Fiers

citation.text: "Fiers", section "Judgment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llawan has the chasm rebels massacred and the Cabal abandon Laquatus in Krosa, with Balthor sent to hunt him, ending his threat.
timeline.quote: This finally ended Laquatus's threat to the empire.

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the merfolk responsible for his death, Laquatus

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the Defiled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: he is Balthor, zombified by Braids and instructed to kill Laquatus.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: forced to strike down the mind-controlled zombie Balthor
relations.quote: Kamahl was forced to strike down his old mentor.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: who had been zombified by Braids

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A dwarf who forged Kamahl and Jeska and was defiled, now weeping for what he has lost.

citation.text: Judgment: card flavor text (Judgment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A dwarf war veteran accepted into the barbarian tribe of Auror.

citation.text: "Auror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A dwarf of the Rock Clan driven off by his people, who became an important barbarian chieftain on Otaria and mentor of Kamahl and Jeska.

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Mutual mentor of Kamahl and Jeska, later raised undead by dark magic.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Companion of Kamahl, zombified by Braids.

citation.text: "Braids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Fiers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Judgment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Kamahl's mentor, a dwarf who sacrifices himself, is zombified by Braids, and is struck down by Kamahl.

citation.text: "Kamahl". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Zombie assassin created by the Cabal to hunt Laquatus.
